name: dash-for-cloudflare
description: Dash for Cloudflare — a native SwiftUI client with a stateless OAuth relay
author: Xat <i@xat.sh>(https://xat.sh)

scripts.ios:build: xcodebuild -project apps/ios/Dash.xcodeproj -scheme Dash -configuration Debug -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -allowProvisioningUpdates build && pnpm lint:l10n
scripts.ios:device: xcodebuild -project apps/ios/Dash.xcodeproj -scheme Dash -configuration Debug -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -allowProvisioningUpdates build && pnpm lint:l10n
scripts.ios:test: xcodebuild -project apps/ios/Dash.xcodeproj -scheme Dash -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 17 Pro' -allowProvisioningUpdates -parallel-testing-enabled NO test && pnpm lint:l10n
scripts.typecheck: turbo typecheck && pnpm api:test && pnpm avatars:test && pnpm blossom:test && pnpm dither:test && pnpm globe:test && pnpm ios:build
scripts.lint: turbo lint && pnpm lint:swift && pnpm lint:l10n && pnpm lint:ios-architecture
scripts.lint:swift: swift format lint --strict --recursive apps/ios/Dash apps/ios/DashWidgets apps/ios/DashShare apps/ios/DashFileProvider apps/ios/DashTests apps/ios/DashUITests packages/BlossomColorPicker packages/cloudflare-api packages/gradient-avatars packages/SwiftDitherKit packages/SwiftGlobeKit
scripts.lint:fix: turbo lint -- --fix && pnpm lint:fix:swift && pnpm lint:ios-architecture
scripts.lint:fix:swift: swift format --in-place --recursive apps/ios/Dash apps/ios/DashWidgets apps/ios/DashShare apps/ios/DashFileProvider apps/ios/DashTests apps/ios/DashUITests packages/BlossomColorPicker packages/cloudflare-api packages/gradient-avatars packages/SwiftDitherKit packages/SwiftGlobeKit
